domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Prepare numbers for subtraction
skills.definition: Rewrite quantities into compatible subtraction-ready forms, including normalizing whole or mixed numbers and creating common denominators for fractional parts when needed.
skills.merge_rationale: This continues the K=5 merge because both skills belong to the same preparation phase and often function as prerequisite setup before any subtraction can occur.

skills.name: Subtract and regroup aligned parts
skills.definition: Perform subtraction on compatible whole and fractional parts, including borrowing/regrouping across whole and fractional parts when direct subtraction would otherwise produce a negative fractional result.
skills.merge_rationale: At this coarser level, S04 is best merged with S03 because borrowing is not a separate phase so much as a conditional extension of subtraction execution. In the dossiers, regrouping appears only in the course of carrying out subtraction of aligned parts, making this a meaningful execution-level aggregate.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the computed result to lowest terms or remove zero fractional parts after subtraction.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because simplification remains a distinct post-computation operation with clear diagnostic value even at a coarser grain.

skills.name: Present final answer form
skills.definition: Combine whole and fractional parts as needed and express the answer in an appropriate final form such as a mixed number, fraction, or integer.
skills.merge_rationale: Kept separate because final answer composition is still distinguishable from simplification: some items require recombination or formatting even when no reduction is needed.
